name: Desiree
source:
Desiree is a mistress of the Fell assassins. Second to [url=https://vndb.org/c165574]Lydia[/url] out in the world, she is one of the elite three who rule the Fell. Like Lydia, Desiree seems to have an odd fascination with the [url=https://vndb.org/c165570]MC[/url]. Lydia embraces Desiree as a sister, while Desiree has been in love with Lydia for years.
